96: size_t parse_near_distance(std::string_view value) {
97:     size_t distance = default_near_distance;
98:     const char* begin = value.data();
99:     const char* end = begin + value.size();
100:     const auto [ptr, ec] = std::from_chars(begin, end, distance);
101: 
102:     if (ec != std::errc{} || ptr != end) {
103:         return default_near_distance;
104:     }
105: 
106:     return distance;
107: }

240:     constexpr uint64_t base = 256;
241:     constexpr uint64_t modulus = 1'000'000'007;
242: 
243:     uint64_t highest_base = 1;
244:     uint64_t target_hash = 0;
245:     uint64_t window_hash = 0;
246: 
247:     // calculate first window hash
248:     for (size_t index = 0; index < target.size(); ++index) {
249:         target_hash = (target_hash * base + static_cast<unsigned char>(target[index])) % modulus;
250:         window_hash = (window_hash * base + static_cast<unsigned char>(source[index])) % modulus;
251: 
252:         if (index + 1 < target.size()) {
253:             highest_base = (highest_base * base) % modulus;
254:         }
255:     }
256: 
257:     for (size_t start = 0; start + target.size() <= source.size(); ++start) {
258:         // compare hash, if hash is same, use simple compare
259:         if (window_hash == target_hash) {

262:                 ++compare_count;
